static_traits.name: Li Jie
static_traits.social_status: Reduced socializing, have not yet confided troubles to friends, worried they do not understand
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no prior similar psychological problems or psychotherapy history
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, can describe emotions and impact in detail; thinking leans negative, with frequent catastrophizing, overgeneralization and negating the positive; cooperativeness Good, can accept structured suggestions but remains skeptical; frustrated tone, with automatic thoughts like 'I cannot do it / meaningless'

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling trapped by the current lifestyle, strongly longing to learn a new language and explore different cultures; boredom and lack of accomplishment have intensified over the past year, especially noticeable when watching foreign-language films and shows, with long hours on the computer yet no progress toward the goal.
basic_info.core_demands: Hopes to ease the mind-body impact of stagnation and dissatisfaction, and to gain a more structured plan or accountability to advance language learning and self-improvement.
growth_experiences: About a year ago began feeling life is monotonous and lacking growth, triggering boredom and dissatisfaction; as long hours in front of the computer brought no progress toward the goal (learning the language), these feelings gradually intensified, forming a cyclical experience of 'the more foreign-language content watched, the more frustrated'.

Multiple attempts at self-studying the new language (using apps, watching tutorials), interrupted whenever hitting obstacles, accumulating experiences of 'minimal progress / futile efforts in vain', gradually eroding self-efficacy and forming a pessimistic anticipation of learning success.

Due to decreased drive and boredom, reduced social interaction, sleep disturbance, and lower work engagement; maintains an avoidant attitude toward outside support, worried friends 'do not understand', and has not yet sought help from friends.

core_beliefs: I do not have the ability to learn a new language
If I cannot see results soon, it means I am a failure

special_situations.event: Can hardly understand dialogue when watching foreign-language movies or TV shows
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot understand now, it means I will never learn; being unable to learn 'naturally' means I am not suited for language learning
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding systematic learning or quickly giving up practice to dodge feelings of failure and shame; reducing discussion with others to avoid exposing inadequacy
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never learn the new language, and I cannot go to other people's countries

special_situations.event: Encountering difficulties or stalled progress in self-study
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I still cannot get past a sticking point, it means I am simply not capable, and continuing is meaningless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Immediately stops practicing or switches tools, reducing engagement to avoid further frustration
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is too meaningless, I should give up

special_situations.event: Long hours in front of the computer yet feeling no progress toward the goal
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If there is no obvious progress right now, it equals having wasted time all along, and my life is stuck
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continuing passive browsing or procrastination instead of structured practice, to temporarily numb the sense of powerlessness
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am just wasting my life; this state will continue forever

special_situations.event: Wondering whether to confide current troubles to friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I speak up, they will not understand either, and I will only appear very incompetent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Chooses silence and self-enclosure, avoiding help-seeking and feedback

core_conflict.wish: Longs to grow, to be seen, and to have their abilities and worth affirmed; hopes to broaden life's boundaries by learning a new language
core_conflict.fear: Afraid of exposing incompetence and failure, worried about being negated, being judged as 'cannot do it', and that efforts remain futile
defense_goal: Avoiding failure and shame through withdrawal and giving up
Using interpretations like 'meaningless / not suited' to maintain self-esteem boundaries and a sense of safety

object_relations.self_representation: Powerless, frustrated learner, a failure who gives up easily
object_relations.object_representation: High demands, others who may judge and negate (or a learning task hard to master)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes setting smaller, more achievable goals and restructuring thoughts
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing small steps are 'meaningless / go nowhere', worried about being demanded to do useless work (interpreting real difficulties as inevitable failure)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Respond in a hesitant and questioning tone, repeatedly using 'but' and 'seems useless too', to weaken the feasibility of suggestions.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking of talking to friends about boredom and stagnation or seeking support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Feeling friends will not understand, and may even secretly negate (projecting inner worries onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Avoiding contact and self-disclosure, using brief replies or displacing topics to cut off possible deeper exchanges.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When hitting a sticking point in learning and seeing no results in the short term
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interpreting frustration as failure of one's own ability and shame, with inner attacks turning against the self
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a tone dominated by self-blame and negation (like 'I am not suited' / 'I just cannot do it'), then interrupting practice to lower anxiety.

manifestations: Subjectively experiences it as 'being stuck/wasting my life'
Long hours on the computer yet feeling no progress, lacking satisfaction and meaning in life
Anticipation of failure in language learning reinforced the feeling of futile, fruitless efforts
outcomes: Increased sleep disturbance and sense of frustration

manifestations: Worried 'they will not understand', therefore not seeking help, not expressing
When goals are blocked, bears it alone more rather than connecting with others
outcomes: Support system not yet activated, emotion-regulation resources insufficient
Helplessness and self-doubt worsen, the avoidance cycle reinforced

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Believing friends 'will not understand', therefore unwilling to start conversations or seek help
Presets others' negative stance in interpersonal settings outside counseling, reducing contact

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent self-blame and self-denial (like 'I am not suited for language learning')
Skeptical and cautious about small goals and gradual action; finds it hard to give oneself affirmation

positive_force: Has a genuine and lasting motivation for learning new languages and exploring cultures
Able to notice the problem's impact on life and health and proactively seeks counseling support
Has awareness of one's need for 'structured plans and external prompting', willing to try small goals
Having several friends to talk to (potential support not yet activated)
negative_force: Negative thinking patterns like catastrophizing, overgeneralization, mental filtering and mind reading reinforce anticipation of failure
Lacks a structured path and external prompting; a habitual reaction of giving up when encountering obstacles
Social withdrawal and not seeking help leave support resources not yet utilized
Long periods of passive internet use and procrastination further weaken motivation and disrupt routine

target_behavior.behavior: When hitting a stuck point in language learning, quickly gives up/interrupts practice
antecedent: Difficulties arising during self-study or no results in the short term yet
Feeling strong frustration after watching foreign-language films
target_behavior.core_reason: Holding the core belief of 'I am not suited / will never learn' and catastrophic anticipation, withdrawing to avoid failure and shame
target_behavior.function: Escaping frustration and anxiety, briefly reducing discomfort
target_behavior.consequence: Learning progress is blocked, self-efficacy drops further, forming a negative cycle of 'frustration - giving up - more frustration'

target_behavior.behavior: Reduced socializing and avoiding seeking help (not expressing troubles to friends)
antecedent: Thinking of talking with friends when feeling bored and dissatisfied
target_behavior.core_reason: Avoidance driven by mind reading and shame, fearing being negated or exposing inadequacy
target_behavior.function: Avoids potential evaluation or embarrassment, maintaining a surface sense of safety
target_behavior.consequence: Support system still not utilized, isolation worsens, negative emotions and helplessness intensify

target_behavior.behavior: Passively spending long periods in front of the computer rather than doing structured practice
antecedent: Feeling life is monotonous, lacking meaning and motivation
Seeing no learning results in the short term
target_behavior.core_reason: Using procrastination and distraction as avoidance to lessen powerlessness and anxiety
target_behavior.function: Short-term self-soothing and distraction, reducing present discomfort
target_behavior.consequence: Daily routine disrupted, motivation and performance declining further, forming a more pessimistic outlook on the future
